senses.gloss: m. = h. נֵפֶל, untimely birth, not viable.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Leviticus 22:27">Targ. Y. I Lev. XXII, 27</cite> <he>דלא נְפִיל</he> (ed. Vien. <cite ref="N01041"><he>נָפִיל</he></cite>, ed. Amst. <cite ref="N01041"><he>נֵפִיל</he></cite>) that it is not an untimely birth.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 58:9">Targ. Ps. LVIII, 9</cite> Ms. (ed. <cite ref="N01022"><he>נְפוּלָא</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 3:16">Targ. Job III, 16</cite> <cite ref="N01043"><he>נִפְלָא</he></cite> (Bxt. <cite ref="N01058"><he>נְפֵלָא</he></cite>; Ms. <cite ref="N01058"><he>נָפְלָא</he></cite>).—Pl. <cite ref="N01061"><he>נִפְלֵי</he></cite>, <cite ref="M01772"><he>נִי׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 101b">B. Bath. 101ᵇ</cite> <he>בדנ׳</he> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 30, ed. <he>בנ׳</he>) it means a lot set aside for burying untimely births.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 102b:2">Ib. 102ᵇ</cite> <he>תרתי בנ׳ וכ׳</he> we do not presume two lots to be set aside for &c.
